blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Fairgrounds after the season ends, amphitheater ruins, pilgrimage fields, civic parks after a major event, and exposition grounds reused by nearby communities long after their original program disappears.
World relation: Open World gathering and Crafted World performance. Continuity survives through repeated preparation, food, games, and local reuse rather than exact reenactment.
Connection to newer locations: It relates to the Orchard of Borrowed Moons, City of Rainward Roofs, Fulgurite Savannah, Museum of Unfinished Rooms, and Last City of Many Forms.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: An absent central performance does not make present celebrations meaningless. Communities can inherit a ritual shell and create honest new traditions inside it.
